context: M22 o8. (Nick.) Varelas office, lights low. The phone. Lisle's voice, perfectly calm.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Nicholas. Historic night. People will make rash decisions. Don't.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: Come to the Pennsylvania. We'll reassure our partners. Together.

lines.speaker: char.howard_lisle
lines.text: That your signature is still worth what they paid for it.
